confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force login attempt to a successful unauthorized login from an unusual IP, followed by privilege escalation, bulk cross-departmental data exfiltration, and log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: Multiple failed login attempts for user_09 from an unusual IP (23.129.64.222) during off-hours.
Successful unauthorized login for user_09 from the suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_09 elevated their role to admin.
Data exfiltration: Bulk downloading of files across multiple departments (Marketing, Sales, Finance, Logs) that are outside the user's normal directory scope.
Anti-forensics: Deletion of authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log) to conceal the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether user_09's credentials were stolen via phishing or if this was a direct brute-force success.
Confirmation of the destination of the downloaded files to confirm exfiltration.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_09's account after a series of failed login attempts from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, performed a bulk download of sensitive files from the Sales, Finance, and Logs departments, and finally deleted the authentication logs to cover their tracks.
